# sensenova_si_pkg — Origin

## Source

- **Copied from**: [OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-SI](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-SI)
  (Apache-2.0) — the official inference package for SenseNova-SI
  (BAGEL / InternVL / Qwen variants)

## Local modifications
